declared_process_behavior.meaning: Four ship-to-shore cranes are assigned to MV Cape Ferrol at Berth 8 for the whole of 2026-08-13, with no maintenance restrictions. They operate during container gang shifts: 08:00-17:00 EDT and 18:00-23:00 EDT, with a break from 17:00-18:00 EDT. They resume at 18:00 EDT on 2026-08-13 to finish the Cape Ferrol load.
declared_process_behavior.operating_meaning: The cranes operate during the ILA container gang shifts: 08:00-17:00 EDT and 18:00-23:00 EDT, with a one-hour break from 17:00-18:00 EDT. On 2026-08-13, they resume at 18:00 EDT to complete the remaining 58 moves on MV Cape Ferrol.
declared_process_behavior.rate_meaning: Sustained average of 23 moves per crane-hour on vessels of this class, which is 92 gross moves per hour with four cranes working.
